summary.zh: 把当前对话整理成交接文档，供下一个会话接手
summary.en: Turn the current session into a handoff doc the next agent can pick up

description.zh: 把当前会话压缩成一份交接文档，写清目标、已定的决策、下一步和风险，并用路径或链接引用已有的 PRD、计划和提交，而不是复制内容。适合中途换人接手、收工前留档，或新会话需要接着做的时候。
description.en: Compacts the session into a handoff document covering goals, decisions, next steps and risks, and references existing PRDs, plans and commits by path instead of copying them. Use it when someone else takes over.
